content: The dissertation says the enemies stirred up the scholars of Herat so that Shāhrukh summoned him to the capital 'to be tried again'; on this 'second trip' he wrote Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I and the creedal tract R. Iʿtiqādāt, both dated 829/1426 and addressed to Shāhrukh, and again earned Shāhrukh's favour and returned to Fars.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I; R. Iʿtiqādāt
